_note: Curated annotations, NOT from NASA pages. Tiers are derived from the challenge statement: tier 1 = named explicitly as fire-safety studies (prevention/detection/suppression); tier 2 = named as relevant/related or ground analysis of tier-1 data; tier 3 = other combustion investigations 'still relevant to fire safety, just not as strongly or directly'. Edit freely.

PSI-26.habitat_relevance: material flammability in ventilated cabins; N2 suppression

PSI-25.habitat_relevance: flame spread/extinction limits vs airflow and O2 below 21%; feeds SoFIE

PSI-98.habitat_relevance: large-scale fire growth in a spacecraft-sized volume (Cygnus)

PSI-99.habitat_relevance: multi-material flammability (silicone, PMMA, Nomex, SIBAL) vs 1-g screening

PSI-102.habitat_relevance: smoke particle size in microgravity -> smoke detector design

PSI-101.habitat_relevance: reflight of SAME, new materials and M-pass instrument

PSI-69.habitat_relevance: limiting oxygen index of liquid fuels; CO2/He/SF6 suppressant efficacy; cool flames

PSI-68.habitat_relevance: extinction boundaries over 0.5-3 atm and 10-40% O2

PSI-20.habitat_relevance: steady burning without airflow in elevated-O2 atmospheres (10.2 psia/26.5%, 8.2 psia/34%) — directly relevant to Moon Base/rover atmospheres; challenges 'turn off ventilation' strategy

PSI-47.habitat_relevance: detector instrument qualification; lunar/ISS dust vs smoke discrimination

PSI-39.habitat_relevance: cool flames of liquid fuels, pressure 0.25-5 atm, He dilution

PSI-159.habitat_relevance: highest O2 concentrations tested in microgravity (up to 85% O2 inverse flames per challenge statement)

PSI-10.habitat_relevance: soot inception and extinction limits (peak T < 1130 K) of spherical flames

PSI-21.habitat_relevance: extinction limits and soot of dilute coflow flames

PSI-22.habitat_relevance: electric field used to mimic partial gravity (per challenge statement)

PSI-23.habitat_relevance: radiative vs kinetic extinction; ~21% and ~30% O2 atmospheres

PSI-106.habitat_relevance: flame liftoff/stability; same SPICE duct as BASS

PSI-107.habitat_relevance: smoke points/soot of non-buoyant flames; duct reused by BASS/BASS-II/SLICE

PSI-62.habitat_relevance: predictive flammability limits for spacecraft materials from BASS data ('Goldilocks' zone)

PSI-60.habitat_relevance: soot 1g vs 0g discrepancy from SPICE images

PSI-142.habitat_relevance: hot/cool/warm flame flammability diagram vs O2 and pressure
